examples: The house was silent at night.
The class was silent for the test.
The forest was silent after the snowfall.
The crowd fell silent when the music began.
She stayed silent because she did not know the answer.
Our shoes are similar. They are both blue.
A lemon is similar to a lime.

more.def: Alike in many ways, but not exactly the same.
examples: A wolf looks similar to a large dog.
Their voices are so similar that I mix them up on the phone.
The two towns have similar weather.

more.def: Easy to understand or do; not hard or complicated.
examples: The directions were simple, so we finished quickly.
She wore a simple blue dress.
There is a simple way to fix the problem.
